text:
elena: Quick broadcast  runtime team flipped prefetch-econ-v5 into hosted canary (18%) at 2034567890. dropping a short summary and rollout notes here. :loud_sound:

deploy-bot: release elena/prefetch-econ-v5 -> canary (18%) succeeded. details: https://internal.redwood/deploys/2034567890

elena: Headline numbers (canary slice vs baseline): p50 -24% (50ms -> 38ms), p95 -20% (160ms -> 128ms), p99 -28% (420ms -> 302ms). token cost per request -16%. GPU busy fraction down ~10%.

samir: Nice! any model families that lost out?

elena: Short and convo routes win most. Very long contexts (>=3000 tokens) show slight p99 drift on a couple routes (~4%); cost still improves. Per-model/per-length matrices uploaded to telemetry: https://internal.redwood/telemetry/prefetch-econ-v5

diane: Product check  will outputs change? regressions?

elena: No model changes. Ran full eval & prompt-regression suite; all clear. If you see anything strange, tag #eng-runtime immediately.

ops-bot: canary health: 2034567890 -> healthy (25m), error rate below threshold, CPU/GPU stable.

infra: Adjusted GPU eviction alerts and added a short kernel-fallback monitor for the canary pool. We'll page if kernel-fallback > 0.5% or p99 drift > 15% in any route.

diane: Rollout plan & rollback command? need for the runbook and paging.

elena: Runbook posted: stay at 18% for 24h, if p99 stable expand to 50% then 100% over 48h. Rollback key: runtime.prefetch_econ=false. Immediate operator toggle below:

```
# rollback toggle
redwoodctl feature set runtime.prefetch_econ=false --scope=hosted --selector=canary
```

marketing: Can we get a 1-sentence blurb and a single slide for the weekly digest?

elena: Yes  I'll drop a one-slide summary + econ table in the docs channel.

samir: Suggest adding a short long-context smoke in the canary pipeline (2 prompts ~3k tokens) to be safe.

elena: Good call  adding a 3-minute long-context smoke step now, will post when live.

diane: Please cc infra@ and product-sre@ before the 50% flip so oncall can monitor dashboards.

elena: Will do. Huge shoutout to the runtime crew (Samir, Arif, Lena) for iterating on the prefetch heuristic and the burst controller. :tada:

ops-bot: note: next checkpoint = 2034569400 (24h).

elena: Thanks all. We'll publish a short retro with final econ tables and per-route notes after the 72h window.
